questions.questionTextEn: Under which of the following articles the President of India can suspend the enforcement of Fundamental Rights (except Articles 20, 21)?

questions.questionTextHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा आवश्यक रूप से किसी राज्य में राष्ट्रपति शासन की घोषणा का परिणाम नहीं है? 1. राज्य विधान सभा का विघटन 2. राज्य में मंत्रिपरिषद को हटाना 3. स्थानीय निकायों का विघटन नीचे दिए गए कोड का उपयोग करके सही उत्तर चुनें:
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (B). The Proclamation of the President's rule in a State can be made in accordance with the provisions of Article 356 of the Indian Constitution at the instance of failure of constitutional machinery. In the event of imposition of the President's rule in a State, the Governor removes the council of Ministers and runs the administration with the help of the secretary of the State. Besides, the President can dissolve or prorogue the legislative Assembly however it is not necessary to do so. Dissolution of local Bodies is not a consequence of the proclamation of the President's rule in a state.
